title: Why this page, and what the premise check trimmed
body: A scaffolded site already turns media on: it binds the bucket, declares the adapter's `media` block, builds the public resolver, and mounts the media route. The reference pages list each piece. A walkthrough that turns media on would repeat both.

The page now covers what a developer changes on a site that has media: the upload limits, the image URLs, responsive images, failing the build on a missing asset, which references the Library counts, and uploading from a custom admin screen. A hand-built site gets the three pieces named in Before you begin, each with its reference link. The outline entry's job and covers were rewritten to match.

title: Document the preview workaround, or fix the engine first?
body: The edit page's live preview builds `/media/<slug>.<hash>.<ext>` paths whatever `publicBase` says (`EditPage.svelte:1359`, `resolve-media.ts:141`). On a site that moves `publicBase`, preview images 404 unless the `/media` route stays mounted too.
The section tells the reader to keep the `/media` route beside the new one. That works, but it documents an engine bug as a step.

choices.label: Keep the workaround
choices.done: The page ships with the extra route step, and the preview bug is filed for a later engine pass.

choices.label: Fix the engine first
choices.done: The session files the preview fix as an engine pass to land before this page is drafted, and the step comes out then.

title: Keep the custom-screen upload section as it is?
body: The typed `mediaUpload` action stores the bytes and commits no manifest row, so a custom screen's upload resolves as missing until an entry save records it. `mediaLibraryUpload` commits the row itself, but the typed `CairnAdminRoutes` contract leaves it out, so typed code reaches it only through a spread or a cast.
The section documents both paths as the code stands. A typed committing path in the engine would make the section shorter and safer.

choices.label: Keep the section
choices.done: The section ships as written, and the typed-path gap is filed for a later engine pass.

choices.label: Fix the seam first
choices.done: The session files an engine pass to add `mediaLibraryUpload` to the typed contract before this page is drafted.

title: Keep the Cloudflare request-size cap?
body: Five lines rest on `f:9awije`: Cloudflare caps a Worker's request body by the account's plan and answers a larger request with a 413 before the Worker runs. The fact cites Cloudflare's Workers limits page. No code in this repo can confirm it, so the fact-check returned all five as unsupported.
It explains a real failure: raising `maxUploadBytes` past the plan's cap does nothing, and the upload fails with a 413 the engine never sees.

choices.label: Keep the cap
choices.done: The five lines stay, sourced to Cloudflare's limits page.

choices.label: Cut the cap
choices.done: The lines go, along with the failure row for a 413 the engine never sees.

title: Facts and a reference page corrected while authoring
body: `f:fxit31` said the Library counts only a top-level image field. The code counts nested image fields at any depth, so the fact and `extractMediaRefs`'s doc comment were corrected. The resolver claim for an uncounted reference was wrong and now says what the code shows: the resolver never sees it.
`docs/reference/log-events.md` said `media.uploaded` writes the manifest row. It doesn't, and that row is fixed on this branch under the fix rule.
